title: Claude Code: Zero to Proficient
heroHeadline:
Claude Code, from
zero to proficient.
heroSub: A hands-on course I built for myself first — designed the way I'd design any course: clear objectives, real practice, and a security thread running through every lesson instead of bolted on at the end. Eight lessons, one entry point, taught live inside the tool itself.
description: A hands-on Claude Code course by instructional designer John Crawford — slash commands, skills, hooks, subagents, MCP, memory, and plan mode, taught with a security-first throughline. Lesson 0 free.
curriculumIntro: Each one builds on the last — mental model first, then a real exercise in your own environment, then a check for understanding before you move on.
gateHeadline: Want the rest of the lessons?
gateBody: The rest of the course is invite-only while it's in early release. Request access and I'll set you up with a login.
